headline: Japan Public Pension Fund Records 5.2 Trillion Yen Loss in Third Quarter
summary: Japan's public pension fund logged a 5.2 trillion yen loss during the third quarter.
why: Large institutional pension funds manage massive asset allocations, and quarterly portfolio swings reflect broader financial market volatility.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Massive portfolio losses for the national pension fund highlight domestic and international asset market drawdowns.
